description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'LifeCycle' responsible for managing the lifecycle of a mock server, including starting, stopping, binding ports, and handling server events within the MockServer project.

classes.name: LifeCycle
classes.description: An abstract class managing the lifecycle of a mock server, including startup, shutdown, port binding, and event handling within the MockServer framework.

methods.name: stopAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the server, disconnects channels, stops HTTP state, shuts down schedulers and event loops, and completes a future with a status message.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the server synchronously, waiting up to 10 seconds for shutdown.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the server by invoking stop().

methods.name: getEventLoopGroup
methods.description: Returns the worker event loop group used by the server.

methods.name: getScheduler
methods.description: Returns the scheduler instance used by the server.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the server's boss and worker groups are not shutting down.

methods.name: getLocalPorts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of ports the server is bound to.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Deprecated method; use getLocalPort() instead. Returns the first bound port.

methods.name: getLocalPort
methods.description: Returns the first port the server is bound to.

methods.name: bindServerPorts
methods.description: Binds the server to a list of requested ports and returns the actual ports bound.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an ExpectationsListener to be notified of request matcher updates caused by API calls.
